scholarships.name: SC/ST/PwD Tuition Fee Waiver
scholarships.eligibility: Applies automatically to B.Tech students admitted under the SC, ST, or PwD reservation categories, as shown separately in the institute's official fee schedule.
scholarships.benefit: Full waiver of the semester tuition fee (marked NA in the fee schedule) across all four years; hostel, mess, and other semester dues still apply.

scholarships.name: Institute Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Open to UG students whose cumulative SGPA over a two-semester window is at least 8.50 and whose parental income is below Rs 5 lakh a year; capped at about 3% of each program's strength.
scholarships.benefit: Rs 36,000 a year, credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account under the DBT scheme rather than as cash or cheque.

scholarships.name: Institute Merit Incentive Award
scholarships.eligibility: Open to UG students whose cumulative SGPA over a two-semester window reaches 9.00 or higher, limited to about 2% of each program's strength; recipients cannot also hold the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship in the same period.
scholarships.benefit: Rs 36,000 a year, disbursed the same way as the Merit-cum-Means Scholarship.
